motion.name: device-arrival
motion.purpose: One native 3D turn when a session recognizes a model. Reduce Motion uses the resting pose.

motion.name: control-selection
motion.purpose: Keep the listening-mode selection legible as it changes.

motion.name: control-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal related controls and small state updates.

motion.name: page-change
motion.purpose: Fade in a new page without moving the toolbar.

motion.name: control-press
motion.purpose: Confirm a button press without delaying the command.

narrative.overview: Native app with a pale device portrait, charcoal control groups, and lavender selected states. SwiftUI/AppKit controls and RealityKit geometry; there are no web component previews.
dos: Do distinguish demo data, connected state, pending writes, and device errors.
Do keep permission and connection controls available while motion plays.
donts: Don't replay the arrival animation on battery, settings, or ordinary navigation changes.
Don't invent model/finish matches for unknown Bluetooth identities or copy proprietary art.
